core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT and ERK
name: IGF1R and ALK/LTK signaling to PI3K/AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are tyrosine-kinase receptor events (IGF1R-SHC/IRS/SOS, ALK/LTK, autophosphorylation) feeding PI3K/AKT and ERK activation, distinguishing them from MET/ERBB receptor themes and from RAS/MAPK negative-feedback themes.

name: Steroid and xenobiotic metabolism including cytosolic sulfonation
rationale: All three members concern biotransformation of steroids and xenobiotics, and the sulfotransferase conjugation step separates this theme from confusables built on CYP oxidation, acetylation and amino-acid conjugation.

core: Actin filament dynamics in cell motility
qualifier: leading-edge protrusion with severing, capping and crosslinking
name: Leading-edge actin polymerization, severing and protrusive motility
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization, severing, capping, crosslinking and lamellipodium/ruffle/pseudopodium protrusion for motility, unlike confusables centred on filopodia and parallel bundles, Arp2/3 activation by WASP/WAVE, or focal adhesions.

name: Aromatic xenobiotic conjugation by amino acids, acetylation, methylation
rationale: Members detoxify benzene-containing and nitrogenous compounds (paracetamol, benzoate, salicylate, phenylacetate) by glycine/glutamine conjugation, acetylation, methylation and CYP2E1, distinguishing them from general xenobiotic catabolism and from drug-specific ADME themes.

name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral gene expression signature
rationale: All members are transcriptional signatures of the type I IFN antiviral response (IRF2 target networks, IFN-alpha response), whereas confusables cover specific effectors such as ISG15, OAS, PKR or cytosolic DNA sensing.

name: Gluconeogenesis from alanine, glycerol and oxaloacetate precursors
rationale: Members cover gluconeogenesis and the metabolism of its carbon sources (alanine, glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate, oxaloacetate, alditols, fructose synthesis), distinguishing the theme from fructose catabolism disorders and the pentose phosphate shunt.

name: Perinatal lung epithelial differentiation and saccular maturation
rationale: Members concern differentiation of pneumocytes, secretory and bronchial epithelium and saccule development plus perinatal ductus closure, unlike confusables on lung branching and mesenchyme or surfactant metabolism.

core: Regulation of NK cell activation and cytotoxicity
qualifier: NK receptor recognition of MHC class Ib, degranulation
name: NK cell activation and degranulation via MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members regulate NK (and T cell) cytotoxic activation, degranulation and cytokine output through lymphoid-target receptor interactions including MHC class Ib, setting the theme apart from KIR-cluster, tolerance and dendritic/T-cell costimulation themes.

core: Phospholipid transport between and across membranes
name: Phospholipid transfer and flippase-mediated aminophospholipid translocation
rationale: Members cover intermembrane phospholipid transfer (PI/PC ER-Golgi, PI synthesis) and P4-ATPase/TMEM30A aminophospholipid flipping, distinguishing them from ER tethering, glycolipid transfer and calcium-activated scrambling themes.

core: Double-stranded RNA sensing and type I interferon control
qualifier: TLR3 pathway deficiencies and ADAR RNA editing
name: Double-stranded RNA sensing by TLR3/PKR and ADAR editing
rationale: Members concern dsRNA detection (endosomal TLR3 and its HSE-causing deficiencies, PKR) and its dampening by ADAR A-to-I editing and negative IFN regulation, which confusables lacking TLR3 deficiencies or ADAR editing do not share.

name: Integrin and syndecan matrix adhesion in fibroblast migration
rationale: Members link integrin and syndecan engagement of fibronectin/collagen matrix to focal adhesions, stress fibers and fibroblast/endothelial migration, beyond the Rho-kinase, EMT and MET-spreading content of confusables.

qualifier: sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction and egg binding
name: Sperm capacitation and acrosome-dependent egg binding at fertilization
rationale: All members describe sperm preparation and binding to cumulus, zona pellucida and oocyte membrane, unlike confusables on sperm motility/flagellum assembly or the maternal-to-zygotic transition.

core: Regulation of type I interferon induction by cytosolic nucleic acid sensors
qualifier: negative regulation of RIG-I and cGAS-STING, TREX1
name: Regulation of IFN-beta production restraining RIG-I and cGAS-STING
rationale: Members tune IFN-alpha/beta production and response, with emphasis on negative regulators of RIG-I/MDA5 and cGAS-STING such as TREX1, whereas confusables cover the positive IRF3/TBK1 activation arm.

qualifier: renal proximal tubule organic cation and cystine transport
name: Proximal tubule SLC transport of organic cations and cystine
rationale: Members are SLC transporter modules and transport processes of polarized kidney/liver epithelia, with organic cation/anion, alpha-ketoglutarate, cystinuria and proximal tubule members that the amino-acid and urate transporter confusables lack.

qualifier: capping and suppression of telomeric recombination/NHEJ
name: Telomere capping and control of telomeric recombination
rationale: Members regulate telomere end protection (capping, NHEJ and recombination inhibition, t-circle and D-loop control) and recombination-based maintenance, distinguishing them from DNA topology, C-strand synthesis and break-induced replication themes.

qualifier: cationic lysine, arginine and ornithine transport
name: Cationic and neutral amino acid transport, lysine-arginine-ornithine
rationale: Members transport neutral and cationic amino acids, and the lysine/arginine/ornithine transport and its disorders (LPI, HHH syndrome) separate this theme from oligopeptide, polyamine and inositol transport confusables.

name: NGF signaling through p75NTR and TRKA
rationale: Members cover NGF production/processing and its signaling via p75NTR (NRIF, NADE, NF-kB, proteolysis) and TRKA (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, CREB), distinguishing them from NTRK2/NTRK3 and dependence-receptor themes.

qualifier: oxidative-damage DNA glycosylases and their defects
name: DNA glycosylase recognition and excision of oxidized bases
rationale: Members describe damaged-base recognition and cleavage by OGG1, MUTYH, NTHL1 and NEIL glycosylases, including disease defects and APEX1 handoff, unlike confusables on gap-filling long-patch repair or alkylation reversal.

name: Dopamine receptor signaling in synaptic transmission and locomotion
rationale: Members cover dopamine receptor coupling to adenylate cyclase, PLC and beta-arrestin and its role in dopaminergic transmission and locomotion, distinct from confusables on drug-reward behaviors and dopamine synthesis/uptake.

name: Centrosomal microtubule nucleation and stabilization with actin crosstalk
rationale: Members concern centrosome positioning, MTOC microtubule nucleation and stabilization together with actin-linked localization and Rho-citron kinase, unlike confusables on centriole/cilium biology or mitotic spindle orientation.

name: Lung branching morphogenesis and mesenchymal proliferation
rationale: Members drive lung bud elongation, branching, lobe growth and lung mesenchyme proliferation, distinguishing them from salivary/limb epithelial-mesenchymal themes, trachea/vasculature themes and alveolar differentiation.

qualifier: clathrin cargo recognition toward lysosomal degradation
name: Clathrin-mediated receptor internalization toward lysosomal degradation
rationale: Members promote receptor (including GPCR) internalization via clathrin cargo recognition and divert it from recycling to lysosomal catabolism, unlike recycling, LDL-receptor and caveolar/pinocytic confusables.

qualifier: vitamin K gamma-carboxylation and vitamin C
name: Vitamin K, C and E metabolism and gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation of proteins, ascorbate metabolism/transport and vitamin E response, while confusables centre on vitamin D, retinoid or ubiquinone metabolism.

qualifier: non-vesicular lipid transfer at ER contact sites
name: Sphingolipid metabolism and non-vesicular lipid transfer at ER contacts
rationale: Members span sphingomyelin/ceramide synthesis and catabolism plus lipid-transfer-protein movement of glycolipids, C1P and PI/PC at ER tethering sites, unlike Golgi vesicle traffic, lysosomal glycosphingolipid or glycerophospholipid synthesis confusables.

core: Aromatic and histidine amino acid catabolism
name: Phenylalanine, tyrosine and histidine catabolism with BH4 synthesis
rationale: Members cover phenylalanine/tyrosine catabolism (including phenylketonuria), histidine catabolism to formate and BH4 cofactor synthesis, which the generic amino-acid catabolism confusables lack.
